name: Templated.io
description:
Templated is an API and drag-and-drop editor for generating images, videos and PDFs from reusable templates. Design a template once (or import it from Canva), then let Claude render it with new text, images and colors on demand.

With this connector Claude can:
- Render images (PNG, JPG, WebP), multi-page PDFs and MP4 videos from any of your templates by changing layer values
- Browse, search and inspect your templates, layers and pages to know what can be customized
- Create, update, clone and organize templates and folders
- Upload images and fonts from URLs and manage your assets
- Merge PDF renders and check your account usage

Renders are produced by Templated's rendering engine from templates you designed, so the output is consistent, on-brand and ready to use in marketing, e-commerce, social media, documents and automations.

Sign in with your Templated account when connecting. A free plan is available at templated.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Templated.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Templated.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.templated.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Templated.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Templated.io lists 25 MCP tools, including clone_template, create_folder, create_render, create_template, create_upload, delete_folder, delete_font, delete_render, delete_template, delete_upload, get_account, and get_render.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Templated.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Templated.io in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Templated.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Templated.io is developed by Templated. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
